parameter.name: name
parameter.description: Unique name the connection is identified by

parameter.name: authDataType
parameter.description: Provides Auth configurations needed when communicating with a remote HTTP endpoint.

parameter.name: httpVersion
parameter.description: The HTTP version understood by the client

parameter.name: timeout
parameter.description: The maximum time to wait (in seconds) for a response before closing the connection

parameter.name: compression
parameter.description: Specifies the way of handling compression (`accept-encoding`) header

parameter.name: circuitBreaker_rollingWindow_requestVolumeThreshold
parameter.description: Minimum number of requests in a `RollingWindow` that will trip the circuit.

parameter.name: circuitBreaker_rollingWindow_timeWindow
parameter.description: Time period in seconds for which the failure threshold is calculated

parameter.name: circuitBreaker_rollingWindow_bucketSize
parameter.description: The granularity at which the time window slides. This is measured in seconds.

parameter.name: circuitBreaker_failureThreshold
parameter.description: The threshold for request failures. When this threshold exceeds, the circuit trips. The threshold should be a value between 0 and 1

parameter.name: circuitBreaker_resetTime
parameter.description: The time period (in seconds) to wait before attempting to make another request to the upstream service

parameter.name: circuitBreaker_statusCodes
parameter.description: Array of HTTP response status codes which are considered as failures

parameter.name: validation
parameter.description: Enables the inbound payload validation functionality which provided by the constraint package. Enabled by default

parameter.name: laxDataBinding
parameter.description: Enables relaxed data binding on the client side. When enabled, `nil` values are treated as optional, and absent fields are handled as `nilable` types. Enabled by default.
